BiblicalUsage: Techinnah, also spelled Tehinnah, was the son of Eshton, and the father of Ir-nahash. He is named in the line of Judah as the father of the city of Nahash.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the father of a city is worth naming, and Tehinnah's place in Judah's line is kept.
